input.function: async () => { const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('a')].map(a=>({t:a.textContent.trim(),h:a.href})); const out=[]; for(const l of links){const r=await fetch(l.h); const t=await r.text(); const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(t,'text/html'); out.push({l, body:d.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,600)});} return {main:document.body.innerText.slice(0,1500), out}; }
